answer: The vine schedule is applied in thread and lantern shows each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3549 identities would post 734 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
